name: media.ffmpeg
title: FFmpeg command
summary: Run an ffmpeg command on workspace files.
description: The escape hatch: run any ffmpeg command with your own arguments. Inputs and outputs are workspace files; filters are checked for file-reading filters.

args.description: The ffmpeg arguments, without the program name. Use {in:NAME} for an input, {out:FILE} for a declared output and {script:NAME} for a script file. An {out:FILE} may be an image-sequence pattern with one %d or %0Nd frame counter (e.g. {out:f-%03d.png}). Bare braces that are not placeholders are passed through to ffmpeg.

inputs.description: Map of input names to file references. The name is used in {in:NAME} placeholders.

outputs.description: File names to write into the job's output directory. Every plain name must exist after the run. A name may be an image-sequence pattern with exactly one %d or %0Nd frame counter (N 1-9, e.g. f-%03d.png); at least one matching frame must exist, and every matching frame becomes a job output listed in frame order.

scripts.description: Map of script names to their contents. Each script is written to a file in the scratch directory and can be used with {script:NAME}.
